focus: Truck-rental desks in Boston neighborhoods (South End, Dorchester, Roxbury, East Boston, Jamaica Plain, West Roxbury) and just over the line in Brookline, Cambridge, and Somerville — four company-run U-Haul stores, six U-Haul neighborhood dealers, and one Penske location — plus four labor-only options
intro: This first Boston page covers truck-rental locations whose official U-Haul and Penske pages list addresses in Boston neighborhoods or just over the city line: four company-run U-Haul stores (Mass Ave in the South End, Route 9 in Brookline, Central Square in Cambridge, and Somerville) that all publish Sunday hours and stay open until 7:00 PM most weekdays (8:00 PM Fridays), six U-Haul neighborhood dealers in Dorchester, Roxbury, East Boston, and Jamaica Plain (Dorchester Food Co Op on Bowdoin St lists 9:00 AM–7:00 PM every day), and the one Penske desk listed under Boston, in West Roxbury, which is closed weekends. Four labor-only options are included for people who already have a truck or container: Bellhop, Horizon Boston Movers, Mozart Movers, and Continental Moving; none publishes a dollar rate on the pages we checked. Budget Truck Rental, Enterprise Truck Rental, Home Depot rental desks, and other U-Haul dealers are not covered yet. The company-run U-Haul stores list shortened Thanksgiving Day hours (7:00 AM–3:00 PM on November 26), and every dealer listed here shows Thanksgiving as closed. We do not report live truck counts; one-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page itself mentions them.

listings.name: Penske at B & M Auto

hours.notes: Hours from the official Penske location page (Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, Sat and Sun closed). The page marks after-hours key drop as open; the printed key-drop instruction mentions a 1st Avenue lot entrance, which appears to be generic text, so confirm the drop location with the branch.

listings.offersNotes: The official page includes a “Reserve a Truck” path and a “Looking for a one-way rental?” prompt with a phone line (1-844-824-6609). Cargo vans are not listed as this location’s inventory, so the cargo-van flag is off.
listings.visitNotes: Closed weekends per the location page. This is the only Penske location listed under Boston on Penske’s Massachusetts locator. Do not treat the reservation page as live inventory.

listings.name: Bellhop — Boston hourly moving labor

hours.notes: Hours from the footer of the official Boston page: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST, Sun 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST.

listings.offersNotes: The official Boston page offers “Hourly moving help and labor”: “If you don’t need transportation but could use some moving help, Bellhop’s skilled Boston movers make quick work of loading, unloading, and/or rearranging.” The same page says Bellhop is a federally regulated property broker that connects customers with independent labor and/or transportation providers, and mentions last-minute movers when plans change.
listings.visitNotes: Bellhop describes itself as a broker, so the crew may be a partner mover. Book online or by phone and confirm crew availability for your date.

listings.name: Horizon Boston Movers — labor only

hours.notes: The labor-only page does not publish office hours. It says crews can be booked for two hours or a full day, can start at 7am before work hours, and can work weekend-only jobs; call to confirm availability.

listings.offersNotes: The official labor-only page says: “you handle the truck, we handle the work,” and that the crew loads and unloads U-Haul, Penske, Budget, PODS, ABF trailers, or a borrowed pickup, by the hour with no truck required.
listings.visitNotes: Call or use the form with your move date, location, and estimated hours; the page says they confirm availability and give a quote.
listings.feeNotes: No labor rates published on the labor-only page we checked.

listings.name: Mozart Movers — loading and unloading

hours.notes: The loading-and-unloading page does not publish office or crew hours. Call to check availability.

listings.offersNotes: The official page offers labor-only moving help for customers who already have a rental truck, trailer, pod, or storage container — “You handle the driving, and our movers handle the lifting” — including U-Haul loading and unloading help.
listings.visitNotes: Confirm crew availability and the quote for your date before you pick up the truck.
listings.feeNotes: No labor rates published on the loading-and-unloading page we checked.

sources.label: Mozart Movers loading and unloading page

listings.name: Continental Moving — moving labor

hours.notes: The site footer on the moving-labor page says “Open 24 hours, Mon–Sun.” That likely refers to phone or booking availability; confirm crew times when you call.

listings.offersNotes: The official moving-labor page says: “If you already have a rental truck, PODS container, or freight service, we provide the labor you need,” handling loading and unloading while the customer provides the vehicle.
listings.visitNotes: Call with the vehicle type, approximate volume, building type, and preferred date, per the page. Loading and unloading at two addresses are booked as separate sessions.
listings.feeNotes: The page says labor-only service is billed hourly with a two-hour minimum per session, with the rate depending on crew size. No dollar rates are published on that page.
